AGRICULTURE — MOCK EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Milk souring
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Ice melting to water

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Pest and Disease Control? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Pest and Disease Control.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Pest and Disease Control.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Pest and Disease Control.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Pest and Disease Control.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cleaning the Kitchen 9 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Sewing Skills: Constructing? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Cleaning the Kitchen 9 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Sewing Skills: Constructing.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cleaning the Kitchen 9 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Sewing Skills: Constructing.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cleaning the Kitchen 9 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Sewing Skills: Constructing.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cleaning the Kitchen 9 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Sewing Skills: Constructing.

4. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Cleaning the Kit? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Cleaning the Kit.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Cleaning the Kit.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Cleaning the Kit.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Cleaning the Kit.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil Conservation Measures? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil Conservation Measures.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil Conservation Measures.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Soil Conservation Measures.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil Conservation Measures.

7. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 50 °C

8. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Producers

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preparation of Animal Products? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preparation of Animal Products.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Preparation of Animal Products.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preparation of Animal Products.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preparation of Animal Products.

10. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Removing all vegetation

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preserving Animal Products 9 2.6 Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygie? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Preserving Animal Products 9 2.6 Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygie.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preserving Animal Products 9 2.6 Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygie.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preserving Animal Products 9 2.6 Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygie.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preserving Animal Products 9 2.6 Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygie.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water Harvesting and Storage? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water Harvesting and Storage.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water Harvesting and Storage.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water Harvesting and Storage.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Water Harvesting and Storage.

13. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

14. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. newton (N)
   C. watt (W)
   D. pascal (Pa)

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cleaning the Kitchen? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cleaning the Kitchen.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cleaning the Kitchen.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Cleaning the Kitchen.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cleaning the Kitchen.

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal.

17. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Kitchen and Backyard Gardening? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Kitchen and Backyard Gardening.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Kitchen and Backyard Gardening.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Kitchen and Backyard Gardening.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Kitchen and Backyard Gardening.

18. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

19. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Poultry Rearing in a Fold? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Poultry Rearing in a Fold.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Poultry Rearing in a Fold.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Poultry Rearing in a Fold.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Poultry Rearing in a Fold.

20. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preserving animal products? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preserving animal products.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Preserving animal products.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preserving animal products.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preserving animal products.

21. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

22. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Nitrogen gas only

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
23. In three clear sentences, explain Poultry Rearing in a Fold and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Crop Pest and Disease Control and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
